objective: Prespecified two BOLL mechanisms on one traded Chinese ETF, not original-author strategy return replication
source_card: Bollinger official rules and Back into bands screening; locally specified exits/execution/account

indicators.input: causal dividend-adjusted total-return close index; raw closes execute and mark account
indicators.zero_std: percent_b undefined; no new signal, retain previous target; no arbitrary zero imputation

rules.exit: when long: TR_today < middle_today (strict below, not only first crossing)
local_adaptations: Full position long/cash, middle exit, total-return input, next-open execution
Back-into-band screening turned into local mean-reversion hypothesis, upper entry cap prevents entering after exit target already reached
Full position long/cash, middle exit, total-return input, next-open execution

signal_semantics.exit_priority: If already long, evaluate exit only. If flat, evaluate entry only. No same-close exit and re-entry.
signal_semantics.warmup: State may evolve in2018; initial2019 target from last2018 close only; no warmup holdings or profit
signal_semantics.pending: New end-of-day target supersedes any unfilled old target; after-close change executes next global trading-session open
signal_semantics.reinvestment: Month-end schedules same-target execution on next open; if long, only paid cash plus residual cash may buy additional whole lots. No fractional shares, leverage or target resizing while long.
signal_semantics.benchmark: Always-long same ETF, first evaluation open and same month-end cash reinvestment; same fees/slippage/dividend rights and valuation

periods.exposure: All historical market period previously used, including2026; not independent unseen holdout. No fitted parameters or train/test optimization in this batch.

account.friction_split: half commission, half price slippage, minimum fee0
account.dividends: Record-date closing shares establish entitlement; ex-date receivable; cash usable from actual pay-date next eligible trading open, matching previous audited study convention. No withholding modeled.
account.execution: Next session raw open plus side slippage; defer on invalid open or +/-10% ex-cash adjusted prior-close conservative boundary with0.001 tick. No future full-day volume/high-low decision.
account.t_plus_one: No bought units sold on same session; at most one order per day.
account.terminal: Mark raw close plus cash and receivables, no forced liquidation

quality.unknown_missing_session: Fail rather than carry price or assume zero return
quality.posthoc_bar_quality: Nonpositive volume/one-price bars fail data-quality review, not used to select trade fills
limitations: Not orderbook-certified historical fills; conservative daily boundary proxy
Current snapshot and incomplete older dividend announcement as-of chain
Single ETF generalization only; no claimed all-Ashare effectiveness
No cash interest, actual broker min commissions or calibrated impact

statistics.primary: Monthly strategy-minus-same-ETF benchmark net returns; Bartlett HAC lag3 mean CI, two-sided normal p-values Holm corrected across2 strategies at5%. Gate requires mean positive, CI lower>0, Holm p<0.05 and strategy CAGR>benchmark at10bp.
statistics.risk: Report max drawdown improvement separately, does not rescue failed return gate.
statistics.diagnostic: Descriptive full-sample time-series Pearson and Spearman between percent_b_t and TR_(t+5)/TR_t-1. Overlapping 5-session labels; not cross-sectional IC, no significance/admission claim, not an executable return and not used for choosing sign/strategy.
statistics.sensitivity: 0bp and30bp are fixed stress tests, not extra candidates or admission rescue. No promotion to registry without separate evidence review.
